description: Phone number validation, phone number lookup and formatting API. Check whether a phone number is valid and get it in standard formats (E.164, international, national), its country and line type (mobile, fixed line, toll free...). Works offline with Google's libphonenumber rules; the number is not called, stored or logged. Send country (2 letters) when the number has no + prefix. Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).
name: phone_check
